# আদিনা (Adina)

> Original Bangla song by H-sib Music, written, sung and produced by H-sib.

- [Lyrics page](https://h-sib.github.io/hsib-apps/music/bangla/adina/): lyrics in Bangla and romanised English

- [H-sib Music on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/@hsibmusic)
